news.titleEn: Bessent calls for 'dramatic shakeup' at Nvidia, urges outside CEO
news.conclusionEn: Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent urged Nvidia's board to hire an outside CEO after Jensen Huang's resignation and questioned whether the company pushed possibly illicit chip sales to China.
news.conclusionZh: 美财长贝森特呼吁英伟达大换血，外聘CEO
news.whyEn: A sitting Treasury secretary publicly pressuring the world's most important AI chipmaker raises regulatory and export-control risk just before its earnings.
news.whyZh: 财长公开施压全球最关键AI芯片商，出口管制与监管风险骤升
news.detailEn: Huang resigned on Nov. 12 after revelations about his relationship with Alice Huang, a former Megaspeed executive suspected by U.S. intelligence of spying for China; CFO Colette Kress is interim CEO. Bessent pointed to rising Singapore revenue as China sales fell and said other executives should face scrutiny over export-control compliance. He is also at odds with Commerce Secretary Lutnick over the suspected chip diversion. Nvidia reports its first quarterly results without Huang on Tuesday.
news.detailZh: 黄仁勋因与前Megaspeed高管Alice Huang（被美情报部门怀疑为中国间谍）的关系于11月12日辞职，CFO克雷斯任临时CEO。贝森特指出英伟达对华销售下降的同时新加坡收入上升，认为其他高管的出口管制合规也应受审查。他还与商务部长卢特尼克在芯片转运问题上意见不合。英伟达将于周二发布黄仁勋离任后首份季报。

news.titleEn: Stock futures tick higher as traders brace for Nvidia earnings, Anthropic IPO this week: Live updates
news.conclusionEn: U.S. stock futures edged up Sunday night ahead of a week dominated by Nvidia's earnings on Tuesday and Anthropic's IPO, expected to price at $70–$78 a share.
news.conclusionZh: 美股期货微涨，本周聚焦英伟达财报和Anthropic上市
news.whyEn: Both events are referendums on the AI trade that has driven most of the market's gains, so they could swing the major indexes.
news.whyZh: 两件事都在检验推动美股上涨的AI行情，可能左右大盘走向
news.detailEn: Nasdaq-100 futures rose about 0.6% and S&P 500 futures 0.3% after all three major indexes posted their best week since August. Nvidia fell 13% last week, its worst week since April 2025, following Huang's exit, yet analysts still expect revenue and earnings to nearly double year over year. Anthropic is reportedly targeting a valuation of about $1.4 trillion. Energy was last week's best sector, up more than 5%.
news.detailZh: 三大指数上周录得8月以来最佳单周表现，纳指100期货涨约0.6%，标普期货涨0.3%。英伟达因黄仁勋离职上周大跌13%，为2025年4月以来最差一周，但分析师仍预计其营收和利润同比接近翻倍。Anthropic据报目标估值约1.4万亿美元。能源板块上周涨超5%，表现最好。

news.titleEn: Anti-Houthi forces retreat in Yemen as Iran strikes Bahrain in attack on U.S. base
news.conclusionEn: Iran's Revolutionary Guards said they hit a U.S. base in Bahrain with six drones, while Saudi-backed Yemeni forces pulled back from Bab el-Mandeb to defend Aden.
news.conclusionZh: 伊朗无人机袭击驻巴林美军基地，也门亲沙部队后撤
news.whyEn: Renewed attacks around the Gulf and Red Sea threaten oil flows and shipping just as U.S.-Iran diplomacy stalls.
news.whyZh: 海湾与红海冲突再起，威胁石油和航运，美伊谈判陷入僵局
news.detailEn: Bahrain said it intercepted several Iranian aerial attacks, its first since September. The Houthis claimed strikes on Riyadh's airport and two pumping stations on Saudi Arabia's East-West pipeline, which now carries about 4 million barrels a day rerouted to Yanbu; Riyadh did not confirm. Iran's Guards also said two tankers were on fire after hitting mines in Hormuz, which Reuters could not verify. Iran's foreign minister is due in Oman on Tuesday for mediation talks.
news.detailZh: 巴林称拦截了多起伊朗空中袭击，为9月以来首次。胡塞武装声称袭击了利雅得机场和沙特东西输油管道的两座泵站（该管道目前日输约400万桶原油至延布港），沙特未证实。伊朗革命卫队还称霍尔木兹海峡有两艘油轮触雷起火，路透社未能核实。伊朗外长周二将赴阿曼进行斡旋会谈。

news.titleEn: Japan's economy unexpectedly contracts in third-quarter as elevated energy costs bite
news.conclusionEn: Japan's GDP shrank an annualized 0.1% in July–September, missing a forecast of 0.3% growth as higher energy import costs hit net exports and consumption.
news.conclusionZh: 日本三季度GDP意外萎缩0.1%，高能源成本拖累
news.whyEn: The surprise contraction complicates the Bank of Japan's plan to raise rates in December and adds pressure on the yen.
news.whyZh: 意外萎缩让日本央行12月加息更为两难，日元承压
news.detailEn: Second-quarter growth was 1.4%, and year-on-year GDP still rose 1.1% thanks to a low base. Net exports cut 0.6 percentage point from growth even though exports beat expectations in two of three months. Markets still price about a 76% chance of a December BOJ hike, with core inflation at 2.1%. The Nikkei fell about 0.6% and the yen weakened toward 160 per dollar.
news.detailZh: 日本二季度增长1.4%，因基数较低，同比仍增长1.1%。尽管三个月中有两个月出口好于预期，净出口仍拖累增长0.6个百分点。市场仍预计日本央行12月加息概率约76%，核心通胀为2.1%。日经指数下跌约0.6%，日元走弱至接近160兑1美元。

news.titleEn: Trump, Xi and Putin to hold first three-way summit in China
news.conclusionEn: The White House says Trump, Xi and Putin will meet on the sidelines of the APEC summit in Shenzhen this week, the first such three-way meeting.
news.conclusionZh: 白宫称特朗普、习近平、普京本周将在深圳三方会晤
news.whyEn: The leaders of the three largest military powers meeting could shape nuclear arms control, the Iran war and U.S.-China trade.
news.whyZh: 三大军事强国首脑会面，或影响核军控、伊朗战事与中美贸易
news.detailEn: The meeting comes after New START expired in February, leaving U.S. and Russian nuclear arsenals unlimited for the first time in over 50 years. Trump wants to discuss nuclear stockpiles and the Iran war but will avoid Ukraine, though officials do not expect an agreement. Beijing has not confirmed the trilateral meeting. Ukraine's Zelenskyy fears a deal could be discussed without Kyiv.
news.detailZh: 《新削减战略武器条约》2月到期后，美俄核武库50多年来首次不受限制。特朗普希望讨论核武库存和伊朗战事，但不谈乌克兰问题，美方官员也不预期达成协议。中方尚未确认三方会晤。泽连斯基担心各方会在乌克兰缺席的情况下讨论相关安排。

news.titleEn: 'We slept here': Flight delays linger but schedule is back on track for Monday
news.conclusionEn: U.S. airlines expect near-normal operations Monday after a router failure during an FAA upgrade triggered a nationwide ground stop and thousands of cancellations.
news.conclusionZh: 美国航班周一有望恢复正常，此前全国停飞致数千航班取消
news.whyEn: The outage exposed fragile air-traffic infrastructure and cost airlines heavily during the busy pre-Thanksgiving period.
news.whyZh: 暴露美国空管系统脆弱，感恩节前旺季航空公司损失惨重
news.detailEn: Transportation Secretary Duffy blamed a router that overwhelmed systems feeding radar data to controllers during a copper-to-fiber upgrade overseen by L3Harris. Friday saw more than 9,200 cancellations and Saturday nearly 6,700. American Airlines canceled about 13% of its Sunday schedule and JetBlue close to a third. The root cause is still under investigation.
news.detailZh: 交通部长达菲称，L3Harris负责的铜缆改光纤升级中一台路由器故障，导致向管制员传送雷达数据的系统过载。周五取消航班超9200架次，周六近6700架次。美国航空周日取消约13%的航班，捷蓝航空取消近三分之一。根本原因仍在调查中。

news.titleEn: Markets live updates: Coles investigates cybersecurity incident, ASX slips
news.conclusionEn: Coles is investigating a weekend cyber incident with outside experts but says it has found no evidence customer, team or supplier data was compromised.
news.conclusionZh: Coles调查周末网络安全事件，称暂无数据泄露证据
news.whyEn: One of Australia's two biggest supermarket chains being hit raises data-security concerns for millions of shoppers and retailers.
news.whyZh: 澳洲两大超市之一遭网络事件，牵动数百万顾客数据安全
news.detailEn: Operations are continuing as normal, though some customers are having trouble with Liquorland click-and-collect. The ASX 200 opened about 0.1% lower, and the Australian dollar, near 67.7 U.S. cents, is the worst-performing G10 currency this month. RBA minutes are due Tuesday after a 6–3 split vote on November's rate hike.
news.detailZh: Coles运营正常，但部分顾客在Liquorland网上下单到店自提时遇到问题。澳股ASX 200开盘跌约0.1%，澳元约报67.7美分，是本月表现最差的G10货币。澳储行11月加息会议纪要（投票结果为6比3）将于周二公布。

news.titleEn: Rivian, Lucid, Scout CEOs aren't counting on Democrats to restore EV federal support after midterm wins
news.conclusionEn: The CEOs of Rivian, Lucid and Scout Motors say they don't expect Democrats, who take control of Congress in January, to restore federal EV incentives.
news.conclusionZh: 美国三家电动车CEO不指望民主党恢复电动车补贴
news.whyEn: Without the $7,500 tax credit, EV makers must compete on cost, reshaping pricing and investment plans across the U.S. auto sector.
news.whyZh: 没有7500美元补贴，车企只能拼成本，影响定价和投资计划
news.detailEn: The federal credit of up to $7,500 ended after September 2025; sales spiked before the deadline and have since fallen back. Rivian's RJ Scaringe expects a divided government to struggle to pass anything, while Scout's Scott Keogh would prefer support aimed at production. The average new EV still costs more than $54,800, above the industry average of about $51,100.
news.detailZh: 最高7500美元的联邦补贴于2025年9月后取消，到期前销量激增，此后回落。Rivian的斯卡林格认为分裂的国会难有作为，Scout的基奥则希望补贴面向生产端。目前新电动车均价仍超5.48万美元，高于全行业约5.11万美元的均价。

businessTips.explanationEn: Board independence means a meaningful share of directors, and ideally the chair, have no financial or personal ties to management. Independent directors can challenge the CEO, oversee risk and lead succession when something goes wrong. When the CEO and chair are the same person, or the board is full of insiders, problems tend to surface late.
businessTips.explanationZh: 董事会独立性指相当比例的董事（最好包括董事长）与管理层没有财务或私人关系。独立董事能够质疑CEO、监督风险，并在出问题时主导接班安排。如果CEO兼任董事长，或董事会多为自己人，问题往往暴露得很晚。
businessTips.exampleEn: After its CEO resigned, Nvidia named its first-ever separate board chair, a sign the board is taking more control of oversight. Even a small company can add one outside adviser with real voting power to get honest pushback.
businessTips.exampleZh: 英伟达CEO辞职后，公司首次设立独立董事长，表明董事会在加强监督。即使是小公司，也可以引入一位有真正表决权的外部顾问，听到不同意见。

businessTips.explanationEn: Customer lifetime value is the total gross profit you expect from a customer over the whole relationship, not just the first purchase. A simple version is average order profit × purchases per year × years retained. Knowing LTV tells you how much you can afford to spend to acquire a customer and whether retention is worth investing in.
businessTips.explanationZh: 客户终身价值是一个客户在整个合作期内为你带来的毛利总和，而不只是第一单。简单算法是：平均每单毛利 × 每年购买次数 × 留存年数。知道LTV，就知道获客最多能花多少钱，以及值不值得在留存上投入。
businessTips.exampleEn: A cleaning side business earns $40 profit per job; a client books twice a month and stays two years, so LTV is about $1,920. Spending $100 on ads to win that client is clearly worthwhile, and a 10% loyalty discount that keeps them a third year is too.
businessTips.exampleZh: 一份清洁副业每单赚40澳元，客户每月预约两次、平均合作两年，LTV约1920澳元。花100澳元广告费拿下这个客户很划算；用九折会员价让客户多留一年也同样值得。

businessTips.explanationEn: A greenshoe lets IPO underwriters sell up to about 15% more shares than planned. If the stock trades below the IPO price, they buy shares back in the market to support it; if it rises, they exercise the option and get the extra shares from the company at the IPO price. It is a standard tool for stabilizing a new stock in its first weeks.
businessTips.explanationZh: 绿鞋（超额配售选择权）允许IPO承销商多卖出最多约15%的股份。若股价跌破发行价，承销商在市场上回购以托住股价；若股价上涨，则行使选择权按发行价向公司增发补足。这是新股上市头几周稳定股价的常规工具。
businessTips.exampleEn: When an IPO with heavy oversubscription prices, check the prospectus for the over-allotment size. A strong first-day pop plus an exercised greenshoe means the company raised more money; a stock hovering right at the IPO price may be held up by underwriter buying.
businessTips.exampleZh: 像本周这类超额认购的大型IPO定价时，可以查看招股书里的超额配售规模。首日大涨且行使绿鞋，说明公司多融到了资金；如果股价一直贴着发行价，可能是承销商在买入护盘。
